summary: The root نقم (nqm) primarily means to take vengeance or inflict penal retribution upon someone for their actions. It also conveys the sense of punishing someone.
lane: 8 اِنْتَقَمْتُ مِنْهُ ذ I took, or executed, vengeance on him, or inflicted penal retribution on him, for that which he had done: (JK:) or I punished him; (S, Msb, K;) as also مِنْهُ , (Msb, K,) and عَلَيهِ , (TA,) aor. نَقِمَ ; (Msb, K;) and نَقِمْتُ . (K.) -b2- See نِقْمَةٌ .
